**Implementation note:** The prior-low gap gate blocks buys on a gap below the previous low (continuation as a risk); no gap-continuation trade.

## Description

Trades in the direction of a material overnight gap when opening volume, market breadth or early-session price action confirms continuation.

## Where it may fit

Large information-driven gaps with strong opening participation; less suitable for unsupported gaps that fade.

## Vehicles

Liquid equities, index ETFs, index futures.

## Required data

Prior close, pre-market/official open data, intraday bars or trades, opening volume, earnings/news calendar.

## Caveats

Pre-market data quality and opening auction slippage matter; define exact entry windows and no-trade filters.
